title: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A classic, comforting homemade chicken noodle soup made with carrots, celery, egg noodles, herbs, and cooked chicken for a quick weeknight meal.

ingredients.name: parsley or dill
ingredients.quantity: 1/4 cup, finely chopped, stems reserved, plus more for garnish

ingredients.name: dried noodles
ingredients.quantity: 6 ounces (such as egg noodles or short pasta)

steps.instruction: In a large pot or Dutch oven, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, season with salt and black pepper, and cook until softened but not browned, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Add the chicken stock, bay leaves, and reserved herb stems, then bring to a boil over high heat.
Add the carrots, celery, and dried noodles.
Cook uncovered over medium-high heat until the noodles are al dente, about 7 to 10 minutes.
Add the shredded cooked chicken and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes until warmed through.
Remove and discard the bay leaves and herb stems.
Stir in the chopped parsley or dill and adjust seasoning with additional salt and pepper as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with extra herbs if desired.
